title: DesktopPhase06DomainV1
description: Phase-06 domain vocabulary: connectors, usage and cost with provenance, budgets, structured observability, health, and the typed configuration control plane. No definition here carries a credential value; a secret crosses the boundary only as a configured flag, a source and a reference.
$comment: المفردات مغلقة. لا قيمة سرّ، ولا جسم استجابة خام، ولا عنوان يختاره وكيل.

ConnectorId.description: A connector identifier issued by the host at registration.

OperationId.title: OperationId
OperationId.description: A registered connector operation. An agent chooses one of these; it never names a URL.

ConnectorProvider.title: ConnectorProvider
ConnectorProvider.description: The adapter family. polaris.rest is the generic REST connector; polaris.workspace reads the sources of one project.

AuthMode.title: AuthMode
AuthMode.description: OAUTH2 is part of the vocabulary and refused at registration in this build: no official flow is implemented.

KeySource.title: KeySource
KeySource.description: Where the host resolves the connector key at call time. The value never crosses the boundary.

OperationAction.title: OperationAction
OperationAction.description: Every action other than READ is an EXTERNAL_SIDE_EFFECT that waits for a bound approval.

EgressClass.title: EgressClass
EgressClass.description: PUBLIC_HTTPS reaches public addresses resolved and checked at connect time; LOOPBACK is the literal loopback interface only; NONE is a local connector with no network.

HealthState.title: HealthState
HealthState.description: UNKNOWN until measured in this session; a measurement from a previous start is never shown as present health.

CostProvenance.title: CostProvenance
CostProvenance.description: ESTIMATED comes from a price the user entered with its source and is never an invoice; UNKNOWN carries no amount.

BudgetMode.title: BudgetMode
BudgetMode.description: HARD blocks the next call before any effect; SOFT warns and permits.

Currency.title: Currency
Currency.description: An ISO 4217 code. No amount is ever converted between currencies.

DecimalText.title: DecimalText
DecimalText.description: An exact non-negative decimal. Money never travels as a binary float.

ConfigLayer.title: ConfigLayer
ConfigLayer.description: DEFAULT lives in code and is not writable.

SettingValue.title: SettingValue
SettingValue.description: A typed value in its plain JSON form: boolean, integer, decimal or code as text, or a list of short strings. The host parses it against the setting's kind and bounds.

ConnectorOperationV1.title: ConnectorOperationV1

list_pointer.description: PHASE-05: a JSON pointer to a list in the response; its items reach the agent as bounded untrusted data.

item_fields.description: PHASE-05: the fields read from each list item.

ConnectorOperationV1.description: One registered operation: a fixed path template on the connector's base URL, a fixed method and typed arguments. It names no host and no header.

ConnectorAuthStateV1.title: ConnectorAuthStateV1
ConnectorAuthStateV1.description: Whether a key is configured, where it comes from and when it was last set. There is no value field and no length field.

ConnectorInvocationV1.title: ConnectorInvocationV1
ConnectorInvocationV1.description: One connector call as recorded: a bounded summary of untrusted content, never the raw body.

CostV1.title: CostV1
CostV1.description: An amount in millionths of a currency unit with its provenance. UNKNOWN has no amount.

UsageTotalsV1.title: UsageTotalsV1
UsageTotalsV1.description: Totals kept apart by currency and provenance: an estimate and a report are never summed into one number.

PricingViewV1.title: PricingViewV1
PricingViewV1.description: A user-entered price. Every cost computed from it is ESTIMATED, never an invoice.

ObsEventV1.title: ObsEventV1
ObsEventV1.description: A structured diagnostic event: codes only. No prompt text, secret, header, page content or connector payload can be represented.

ResolvedValueV1.title: ResolvedValueV1
ResolvedValueV1.description: One effective value and where it came from. ignored_layers lists a project or mission value that tried to widen a security-bearing setting.

SettingDescriptorV1.title: SettingDescriptorV1
SettingDescriptorV1.description: A typed setting: its kind, bounds, the layers that may write it, whether it bears security, its build ceiling and the host component that reads it. It carries no current value.

SensitiveStatusV1.title: SensitiveStatusV1
SensitiveStatusV1.description: A sensitive setting shown as configured, source and last update only. There is no reveal path.

ConnectorPresetV1.title: ConnectorPresetV1
ConnectorPresetV1.description: A built-in connector preset: the service's official base URL and documented read operations. It carries no credential and no connection state.
